content.text: DSM V combined dysthymia & chronic major depressive disorder into PDD
*criteria for MDD may be continuously present for 2yrs
majority of the day on most days lasting
never been without symptoms >2MO at a time
•combo treatment w/ psychotherapy & pharmacology more efficacious than either alone
frequent temper outbursts + persistent irritable or angry mood between outbursts
•medications for symptom control & comorbidities (stimulants, SSRIs, mood stabilizers, second-generation antipsychotics)
cluster of physical, behavioral, & mood changes w/ cyclical occurrence during the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle
*PRESENT week BEFORE MENSES ONSET, IMPROVE after a few days of onset, MINIMAL/ABSENT week AFTER MENSES ENDS
*must be confirmed by recording of AT LEAST 2 CYCLES
(e.g., mood swings, suddenly tearful, more sensitive)
mood, feelings of hopelessness, or self-deprecating thoughts
, &/or feelings of being keyed up or
, easily fatigued, or lack of energy
breast tenderness/swelling, joint/muscle pain, bloating, weight gain
*underlying cause must be ruled out w/
: improves sxs of bloating & tender breasts
